Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders On December 10, 2024, Microsoft Corporation (the “Company” or “Microsoft”) held its 2024 Annual Shareholders Meeting (the “Annual Meeting”). There were 7,434,436,393 shares of common stock entitled to be voted at the Annual Meeting, of which 6,417,206,480 were voted in person or by proxy.
